slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Holiday road trip? Sometimes the boot gets your back before the highway does 🚗

Leaning deep into the boot with a heavy bag at arm's length is a classic back tweak, so the packing order matters.

Load the heaviest bags first, close to the back seats, so you're not reaching over them later. Rest each bag on the bumper edge, then slide it in rather than swinging it. Several medium bags beat one enormous one. Before you go, set your seat so your knees are slightly bent and your back is supported.

Pain that spreads down a leg, comes with numbness or weakness, or isn't easing after a few days is worth assessing. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.
